set.body:
Current plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md, Full event-graph delivery. Owner approved proceeding 2026-11-16.

Scope: Reuse compiler hierarchy/relation assembly and checked relation types over the bounded paired account. Preserve occurrence identity, participant roles and reference scope; source and recall structures may differ. No separate graph builder or many-atoms-equals-many-events shortcut.

Engineering acceptance artifact: One relation artifact constructed from receipted proposals preserves containment and referential links and their evidence; repeated occurrences, shared participants and a summary spanning events are distinct, while foreign endpoints, cycles in the declared containment hierarchy and prohibited cross-context links are refused or retained as typed gaps.

Scope is one bounded synthetic account and its public path, not a whole-corpus extraction. Use repository reference-scope gates, relevant mutation/compile-refusal evidence and exact-SHA cold review. Graph-wide integration and fresh-data qualification remain on the existing E0 and human-evaluation tickets. Claim this slice, not a parent container.
set.title: [event-graph] Produce scoped event hierarchy and referential links
